data.long_description:
"Riverside Views – Marine 1: Refined Living Along the Waterfront

Riverside Views – Marine 1 is an upscale residential development by Damac Properties, set within the prestigious Damac Riverside community. Comprising two elegant blocks with a ground floor, three podium levels, and 14 residential stories, this project redefines modern waterfront living in Dubai. Its contemporary architecture is enhanced by high-end materials and clean design lines that harmonize with the natural surroundings.

Inside, every detail has been thoughtfully curated to maximize comfort and visual appeal. Expansive windows flood the interiors with natural light while offering sweeping views of landscaped promenades and calm waters. The building’s design emphasizes space, sophistication, and functionality, all set within a community that celebrates relaxation and luxury.

Beyond the residences, residents can enjoy a premium lifestyle with access to a state-of-the-art fitness center, a shimmering swimming pool, tranquil lounge areas, and vibrant waterfront walkways. Culinary experiences await at Portofino and Island Restaurant—perfect for those who enjoy fine dining with a view. Strategically located, Marine 1 ensures effortless access to key city destinations, including Downtown Dubai in just 25 minutes, Dubai Marina in 20, and Dubai International Airport within 35 minutes.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
